label: Diagram 7.1
caption: Diagram 7.1 Examples of door-height glazing not warranting manifestation
description: At the top left, the text reads "See para 7.3". Four line elevations, labelled a to d, stand side by side on a common horizontal floor line. Part a shows a tall rectangle split down the middle by a vertical line; above it two dimension arrows are each marked "<400mm", and the caption reads "a. Glazing less than 400mm in width between frames". Part b shows a rectangle with a horizontal rail across it; a lower dimension arrow from the floor to the rail is marked "850mm to 1000mm" and an upper arrow from the rail to the top edge is marked "1400mm to 1600mm"; the caption reads "b. Glazing with a rail between 850mm to 1000mm and 1400mm to 1600mm above the floor". Part c shows a rectangle containing a smaller inset rectangle, captioned "c. A single pane glazed door with a substantial frame". Part d shows a rectangle divided vertically, each half holding a small elongated handle shape, captioned "d. Glazed doors with no frame, or narrow frames, but with a large handle or push plate on each single pane". A green bar below reads "Diagram 7.1 Examples of door-height glazing not warranting manifestation".
